resources.string: Keep an authenticated ADB TCP listener for restarts without Wi-Fi during this boot. The listener may be reachable from connected networks. Applies on the next start. Turning this off stops future activation. An existing listener remains until ADB restarts.

Monitor the backend and retry when it stops, with an ongoing notification. Start manually once to resume after Stop. Boot recovery also requires Start on boot. Pairing, a usable ADB endpoint and manufacturer background settings still apply.
Reuse local ADB TCP first, then wireless debugging. Enable TCP on start while Wi-Fi is available before trying offline restarts. A reboot may require Wi-Fi again.
